name: The Soft Brickworks
prompt: Press blocks of pale pink confectionery into soft building bricks with a broad wooden stamp. Children stack still-warm bricks into leaning arches on a powdered white yard. One sagging arch is gently propped up with biscuit sticks.

name: The Sugar Umbilicus
prompt: Suspend five clear round incubators from a crimson manifold. A single marshmallow cloud grows in each, progressing from a pinhead to a bulging cushion. Confectioners cut one mature cloud free with huge polished scissors.

name: The Ribbon Glacier
prompt: Send a striped slab of mint, lilac and peach marshmallow creeping down a shallow black ramp. Wire cutters carve slices from its folded leading edge. At the top, beaters aerate three separate pools before their streams come together.

name: Pillows by Post
prompt: Build a low sorting floor full of oversized pneumatic tubes shaped like transparent elbow macaroni. White sugar pillows squeeze visibly around their bends. Workers catch the delivered pillows in pale-blue paper wrappers at a row of flared outlets.

name: The Confectioner's Eclipse
prompt: Set a great horizontal dark cocoa disc above a broad pan of white foam. When lowered it stamps crescent shapes that emerge on bright yellow paddles. Show the smallest crescent moving toward a powdered-sugar sieve.
